## Release impact

Use Conventional Commits for the PR title or squash commit:

- `feat(scope): ...` → minor release
- `fix(scope): ...` → patch release
- `feat(scope)!: ...` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` → major release
- `docs`, `test`, `chore`, `refactor`, `ci`, `build` → no release by themselves

Release notes are generated by release-please after merge to `main`.
